# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 17a: stage 1b ONLY (--dress-only, no stage 2) for the three products still open after QA 0.10.1: skirt, blouse, cardigan.
# Push only after run 16b has finished. Stage 1b QA 0.11.0, Qwen prompt 0.2.0. Thresholds unchanged.
# What is new:
# - Qwen input fixes:
#   - the open-front negative goes with the front only (the cardigan back was told "no closed pullover, no high round neckline");
#   - the back keeps every part on its side of picture 2 (the cardigan's swapped sleeves);
#   - one colour phrase for both views when the shop cut-outs are one colour (blouse: "cream" / "peach", dE 4.7).
# - Draw plans (--dress-draws): several seeds of both engines per view in one container.
#   - keep:<engine>@<seed> carries a view over from run 16a, re-scored with the current QA and never redrawn. Every keep names its seed.
#   - The front/back pair is picked only when both views pass their own QA and back view, view agreement (incl. the waistband)
#     and view colour pass.
#   - stage1b/record.json lists every pair with its failures, each view's torso cover and waistband;
#     every candidate's composite is in stage1b/candidates/stills/.
#   - Each draw is committed to the Volume as it is saved, and downloaded even if the GPU run or the finalize fails.
# - The earlier run (16a) moves to stage1b/history/ on the Volume and comes back in the artifact.
# Job ids are unchanged since 16a (exporter, packages and shop data not changed):
#   skirt 99ab3ce9327b, blouse bf9480eb27c6, cardigan 7c2cdf2348ec.
# A keep that is not in the Volume (or is ambiguous) stops that line on CPU before any GPU time.
# Cost estimate (H100 list price $3.95/h; GPU seconds from run 16a: FASHN about 8 s, Qwen about 68 s per draw, load 15-78 s):
#   skirt about 350 GPU s, about $0.38 (9 draws: 6 FASHN, 3 Qwen, plus the kept 16a back)
#   blouse about 380 GPU s, about $0.42 (13 draws: 10 FASHN, 3 Qwen, plus the kept 16a Qwen front)
#   cardigan about 370 GPU s, about $0.41 (4 Qwen draws, plus the kept 16a Qwen front)
# That model overestimates 16a's blouse by about 25%, so expect about $1.0-1.2 in all, at most about $1.5.
# CPU prepare and finalize: under a cent each. Not the invoice.
# Order: every export (no GPU) runs before the first GPU command. Each modal line ends in || echo ::warning::,
# so one failed product does not skip the others.
# No --accept-failed-dress.
# Review per product before 17b: the pairs table (with each view's torso cover and waistband), the picked stills at 1x and 3x,
# the near-misses in candidates/stills/, and the raw outputs against the shop photos. A pair just over a threshold is not a
# pass by itself: if a qualifying pair with more margin exists, pin that one in 17b.
# Pass criteria:
#   skirt: front waistband within about 10 px of the proxy top (row 348), torso cover >= 0.92, no grey belly,
#          waistband agrees with the kept back.
#   blouse: view colour within its limit, back as light as the front, no grey caps by eye, sleeves level.
#           Flag whatever QA says: hem cut at the proxy hem, sleeve length unmeasured.
#   cardigan: DIAGNOSTIC of the 0.2.0 back prompt, not expected to ship. Its Qwen front (kept, shoulder slope 255 px) and the
#             back size fail on the fitted proxy vs the oversized knit, an exporter decision. Look for: back sleeves camel left /
#             brown right as seen, no button or argyle on the back.
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
# skirt: FASHN drew the front waist about 40 px low with seed 43 (runs 15 and 16a); new FASHN seeds, Qwen's first draws, the 16a FASHN back kept
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt
# blouse: one colour phrase for both views; FASHN front missed torso cover by 0.0003; FASHN back print lost twice; Qwen back orange-brown;
#         the 16a Qwen front kept (its grey caps come from the proxy; same instruction under 0.2.0)
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-blouse
# cardigan: diagnostic, Qwen only (FASHN drew a cropped bolero in runs 15 and 16a); first GPU test of the 0.2.0 back prompt;
#           the 16a Qwen front kept (shoulder slope comes from the proxy; same instruction under 0.2.0)
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt --dress --dress-only --dress-draws "front=fashn@44-47,qwen@43-44;back=keep:fashn@43,fashn@44-45,qwen@43" --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt: run 17a stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/rosewater-blouse --dress --dress-only --dress-draws "front=keep:qwen@43,fashn@44-49;back=fashn@44-47,qwen@44-46" --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::rosewater-blouse: run 17a stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi --dress --dress-only --dress-draws "front=keep:qwen@43;back=qwen@44-47" --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi: run 17a stage 1b (diagnostic) failed"
# Then run 17b (separate push), only for products whose 17a pair passes and survives the human review, end to end without redrawing:
#   --reuse-dress --dress-expect front=<pixel sha256>,back=<pixel sha256>
#   or --recompose-dress --dress-pin front=<engine@seed>,back=<engine@seed> --dress-expect ...
# About $1.6-1.7 each.
